headline: Trump threatens to punish firms over overseas AI data centers
summary: President Trump threatened action against US companies building AI data centers outside the country, though outlets differ on whether he described it as a tax or a ban, and he gave little detail.

claims.statement: Trump threatened a policy targeting US companies that build AI data centers outside the country.

sources.quote: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas

claims.statement: Trump said the US would not allow its companies to build data centers outside the country.

sources.quote: We're not going to allow our companies to build data centers outside of our country

claims.statement: Trump gave little detail on the potential policy, and his own team was reportedly hearing about it for the first time.

sources.quote: The US president provided little detail on the potential policy, saying others in his team were hearing about it for the first time.

discrepancies.explanation: One outlet characterizes the threatened policy as a tax, the other as an outright ban, even though the policy itself remains undetailed.

quotes.quote: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas
